hero.subhead: Hong Kong-based video production, copywriting, and strategic storytelling for organizations that need their work seen, heard, and understood clearly.

intro.title: About Light Up Production
intro.body: Light Up Production is a team of creative professionals specialising in video production, copywriting, and media strategy. Grounded in a decade of journalistic rigor and storytelling sensitivity, we deliver authentic content that resonates with diverse audiences across the corporate, educational, and non-profit sectors.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Video, copywriting, branding, and graphic & visual — built around your message.

items.title: Video
items.body: A great video blends technical precision with narrative depth. We produce corporate profile films, promotional content, event coverage, and human-centric documentaries with deep sensitivity to each client’s unique voice.

items.title: Copywriting
items.body: Words have power, and our copywriting service is designed to harness that power clearly and persuasively. From social media management to publications and campaign messaging, every word is crafted to connect with clarity and purpose.

items.title: Branding
items.body: We build authentic brand identities and messaging frameworks that define your organisation’s purpose, establish a distinct voice, and build lasting trust.

items.title: Graphic and Visual
items.body: From annual reports and corporate publications to digital assets and social graphics, we transform complex ideas into compelling visual narratives.

clients.title: Our Clients
clients.subtitle: Organisations across culture, education, industry, and community.

portfolio.title: Portfolio

founder.title: About Winnie Yip
body: Winnie Yip is an award-winning journalist with a decade of experience across Hong Kong media, and as a Beijing correspondent. Recognized with accolades from the Newspaper Society of Hong Kong and CUHK Journalism Awards, she brings editorial rigor and human-centric storytelling to corporate and community messaging. Before founding Light Up Production, she served as Public Affairs Manager for the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival and produced the documentary When Music is Chosen. She now helps organizations amplify their impact through video, copy, and publications.

contactBand.body: Tell us about your project — video, copy, branding, or graphic & visual. We will reply with clear next steps.
